instruction.name: xvftint.wu.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in `a` to unsigned 32-bit integer, using current rounding mode specified in `fscr`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftint.wu.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftint.wu.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftint.wu.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftint.wu.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftint.wu.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftint.wu.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftint.wu.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftint.wu.s $xr7, $xr15
